azure_blob_storage_linked_service_config.description: (Optional) Configuration for Azure Blob Storage Linked Service using AzAPI. Connection Configuration: - For system managed identity: Specify service_endpoint (e.g., "https:// .blob.core.windows.net/") - For user-assigned managed identity: Specify service_endpoint and credential_reference_name - For account key with Key Vault: Use connection_string (base without key) + key_vault_account_key - For account key inline: Use connection_string_secure (full connection string) - For SAS token with Key Vault: Use sas_uri (base without token) + key_vault_sas_token - For SAS inline: Use sas_uri_secure or sas_uri_key_vault (full SAS URI) - For anonymous access: Use container_uri Fields: name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Data Factory Linked Service. Must be unique within a data factory." data_factory_id = "(Required) The Data Factory ID in which to associate the Linked Service." description = "(Optional) Description for the Linked Service." integration_runtime_name = "(Optional) Integration runtime reference name." annotations = "(Optional) List of tags for describing the Linked Service." parameters = "(Optional) Map of parameters to associate with the Linked Service." AzureBlobStorageLinkedServiceTypeProperties: service_endpoint = "(Optional) Blob service endpoint (e.g., https:// .blob.core.windows.net/). Required for managed identity auth. Mutually exclusive with connectionString and sasUri." connection_string = "(Optional) Plain connection string without account key. Use with key_vault_account_key." connection_string_secure = "(Optional) Connection string as SecureString (inline). Mutually exclusive with connection_string_key_vault." sas_uri = "(Optional) Plain SAS URI without token. Use with key_vault_sas_token." sas_uri_secure = "(Optional) SAS URI as SecureString (inline)." container_uri = "(Optional) Container uri of the Azure Blob Storage resource only support for anonymous access. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." account_kind = "(Optional) Specify the kind of your storage account. Allowed values are: Storage (general purpose v1), StorageV2 (general purpose v2), BlobStorage, or BlockBlobStorage. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." authentication_type = "(Optional) The type used for authentication. Type: string. Allowed values: 'AccountKey', 'Anonymous', 'Msi', 'SasUri', 'ServicePrincipal'." azure_cloud_type = "(Optional) Indicates the azure cloud type of the service principle auth. Allowed values are AzurePublic, AzureChina, AzureUsGovernment, AzureGermany. Default value is the data factory regions' cloud type. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." service_principal_id = "(Optional) The ID of the service principal used to authenticate against Azure Blob Storage. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." tenant = "(Optional) The name or ID of the tenant to which the service principal belongs. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." encrypted_credential = "(Optional) The encrypted credential used for authentication. Credentials are encrypted using the integration runtime credential manager. Type: string." connection_string_key_vault = "(Optional) Key Vault reference for the entire connection string (including account key) stored as a single secret. Use this when you want to store the complete connection string in Key Vault. Object with: linked_service_name, secret_name, secret_version." key_vault_account_key = "(Optional) Key Vault reference for account key only. Use with connection_string (base without key) to store only the account key in Key Vault. Object with: linked_service_name, secret_name, secret_version." sas_uri_key_vault = "(Optional) Key Vault reference for the entire SAS URI (including token) stored as a single secret. Use this when you want to store the complete SAS URI in Key Vault. Object with: linked_service_name, secret_name, secret_version." key_vault_sas_token = "(Optional) Key Vault reference for SAS token only. Use with sas_uri (base without token) to store only the SAS token in Key Vault. Object with: linked_service_name, secret_name, secret_version." key_vault_service_principal_key = "(Optional) Key Vault reference for service principal key. The key of the service principal used to authenticate against Azure Blob Storage. Object with: linked_service_name, secret_name, secret_version." credential_reference_name = "(Optional) User-assigned managed identity credential reference name." Note: This linked service uses the AzAPI provider for comprehensive authentication support including managed identities.

Valid values: 'SQL', 'ServicePrincipal', 'SystemAssignedManagedIdentity', 'UserAssignedManagedIdentity'." # Connection Properties - specify either connection string OR server+database connection_string_key_vault = "(Optional) A connection_string_key_vault block for Key Vault reference to connection string." linked_service_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service." secret_name = "(Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the SQL Managed Instance connection string." secret_version = "(Optional) Specifies the version of the secret in Azure Key Vault. The default value is the latest version." connection_string_secure = "(Optional) The connection string as SecureString. Type: SecureString." server = "(Optional) The name or network address of the SQL Managed Instance server. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." database = "(Optional) The name of the database. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." # SQL Authentication Properties username = "(Optional) The user name to be used when connecting to server. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." key_vault_password = "(Optional) A key_vault_password block for Key Vault reference to password." linked_service_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service." secret_name = "(Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the password." secret_version = "(Optional) Specifies the version of the secret in Azure Key Vault." password_secure = "(Optional) Password as SecureString for SQL authentication." # Service Principal Authentication Properties service_principal_id = "(Optional) The ID of the service principal used to authenticate against Azure SQL Managed Instance. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." tenant_id = "(Optional) The name or ID of the tenant to which the service principal belongs. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." service_principal_credential_type = "(Optional) The service principal credential type. Valid values: 'ServicePrincipalKey', 'ServicePrincipalCert'." # Service Principal Credential (Preferred) key_vault_service_principal_credential = "(Optional) A key_vault_service_principal_credential block for Key Vault reference to service principal credential." linked_service_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service." secret_name = "(Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the service principal credential." secret_version = "(Optional) Specifies the version of the secret in Azure Key Vault." service_principal_credential_secure = "(Optional) Service principal credential as SecureString." # Legacy Service Principal Key (for backward compatibility) key_vault_service_principal_key = "(Optional) A key_vault_service_principal_key block for Key Vault reference to service principal key." linked_service_name = "(Required) Specifies the name of an existing Key Vault Data Factory Linked Service." secret_name = "(Required) Specifies the secret name in Azure Key Vault that stores the service principal key." secret_version = "(Optional) Specifies the version of the secret in Azure Key Vault." service_principal_key_secure = "(Optional) Service principal key as SecureString." # User Assigned Managed Identity Authentication credential_reference_name = "(Optional) The credential reference name for User Assigned Managed Identity authentication." # Connection Tuning Properties encrypt = "(Optional) Indicate whether TLS encryption is required for all data sent between the client and server. Valid values: 'true/yes/mandatory', 'false/no/optional', 'strict'." trust_server_certificate = "(Optional) Indicate whether the channel will be encrypted while bypassing walking the certificate chain to validate trust. Type: Boolean (or Expression with resultType boolean)." host_name_in_certificate = "(Optional) The host name to use when validating the server certificate for the connection. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." application_intent = "(Optional) The application workload type when connecting to a server. Valid values: 'ReadOnly', 'ReadWrite'. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." connect_timeout = "(Optional) The length of time (in seconds) to wait for a connection to the server before terminating the attempt and generating an error. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." connect_retry_count = "(Optional) The number of re-connections attempted after identifying that there was an idle connection failure. Must be an integer between 0 and 255. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." connect_retry_interval = "(Optional) The amount of time (in seconds) between each re-connection attempt after identifying that there was an idle connection failure. Must be an integer between 1 and 60. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." command_timeout = "(Optional) The default wait time (in seconds) before terminating the attempt to execute a command and generating an error. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." load_balance_timeout = "(Optional) The minimum time, in seconds, for the connection to live in the connection pool before being destroyed. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." failover_partner = "(Optional) The name or address of the partner server to connect to if the primary server is down. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." max_pool_size = "(Optional) The maximum number of connections allowed in the connection pool for this specific connection string. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." min_pool_size = "(Optional) The minimum number of connections allowed in the connection pool for this specific connection string. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." multiple_active_result_sets = "(Optional) When true, an application can maintain multiple active result sets (MARS). Type: Boolean (or Expression with resultType boolean)." multi_subnet_failover = "(Optional) If your application is connecting to an AlwaysOn availability group (AG) on different subnets, provides faster detection of and connection to the (currently) active server. Type: Boolean (or Expression with resultType boolean)." packet_size = "(Optional) The size in bytes of the network packets used to communicate with an instance of server. Type: integer (or Expression with resultType integer)." pooling = "(Optional) Indicate whether the connection will be pooled or explicitly opened every time that the connection is requested. Type: Boolean (or Expression with resultType boolean)." integrated_security = "(Optional) Indicate whether User ID and Password are specified in the connection (when false) or whether the current Windows account credentials are used for authentication (when true). Type: Boolean (or Expression with resultType boolean)." azure_cloud_type = "(Optional) Indicates the azure cloud type of the service principle auth. Valid values: 'AzurePublic', 'AzureChina', 'AzureUsGovernment', 'AzureGermany'. Default value is the data factory regions' cloud type. Type: string (or Expression with resultType string)." # Integration Runtime and Metadata integration_runtime_name = "(Optional) The integration runtime reference to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service." encrypted_credential = "(Optional) The encrypted credential used for authentication. Credentials are encrypted using the integration runtime credential manager. Type: string." description = "(Optional) The description for the Data Factory Linked Service." annotations = "(Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Linked Service." parameters = "(Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Linked Service." # Always Encrypted Settings always_encrypted_settings = "(Optional) An always_encrypted_settings block for SQL Always Encrypted properties." akv_auth_type = "(Required) Always Encrypted Azure Key Vault authentication type. Valid values: 'ServicePrincipal', 'ManagedIdentity', 'UserAssignedManagedIdentity'." credential_reference_name = "(Optional) The credential reference name for User Assigned Managed Identity." service_principal_id = "(Optional) The client ID of the application in Azure Active Directory used for Azure Key Vault authentication." service_principal_key = "(Optional) The key of the service principal used to authenticate against Azure Key Vault." Authentication Types Supported: - SQL Authentication: Requires username + password (Key Vault reference or SecureString) - Service Principal: Requires service_principal_id + tenant_id + credential/key (Key Vault reference or SecureString) - System Assigned Managed Identity: No additional authentication properties required - User Assigned Managed Identity: Requires credential_reference_name Connection Configuration: - Specify either full connection string (connection_string_key_vault or connection_string_secure) OR server + database properties - Cannot use both connection string and server+database properties simultaneously Important Constraints: - If service_principal_credential_type is "ServicePrincipalCert", then servicePrincipalCredential can only be AzureKeyVaultSecretReference - If service_principal_credential_type is "ServicePrincipalKey", then servicePrincipalCredential can be either SecureString or AzureKeyVaultSecretReference - All optional connection tuning properties default to null and are only included when explicitly set Note: This linked service uses the AzAPI provider as the azurerm provider doesn't support Azure SQL Managed Instance linked services natively.
